% Bundle: nlchunk_20260426_224415Z_df5d8a6f
% Rule: r_d50570a5ae1d  |  line_index: 0  |  NL: A blue chain is a set of cells such that every cell in the set is in the blue state.
% Rule: r_ef9cc6547b90  |  line_index: 1  |  NL: A blue chain is a set of cells such that every cell in the set is reachable from every other cell in the set through a path of adjacent cells that are all in the set.
blue_connected(R1, C1, R2, C2, T) :- holds(cell_state(R1, C1, blue), T), holds(cell_state(R2, C2, blue), T), adjacent(R1, C1, R2, C2).
blue_connected(R1, C1, R3, C3, T) :- blue_connected(R1, C1, R2, C2, T), blue_connected(R2, C2, R3, C3, T).
blue_chain(R1, C1, R2, C2, T) :- blue_connected(R1, C1, R2, C2, T).
blue_chain(R, C, R, C, T) :- holds(cell_state(R, C, blue), T).

% Rule: r_3666610e08d2  |  line_index: 2  |  NL: A red chain is a set of cells such that every cell in the set is in the red state.
% Rule: r_aa9985d88e94  |  line_index: 3  |  NL: A red chain is a set of cells such that every cell in the set is reachable from every other cell in the set through a path of adjacent cells that are all in the set.

% red_connected(R1, C1, R3, C3, T) :- red_connected(R1, C1, R2, C2, T), red_connected(R2, C2, R3, C3, T).

% Rule: r_c8b790a8a516  |  line_index: 4  |  NL: The red player wins on a turn if there is at least one red chain that contains at least one cell on the top edge and at least one cell on the bottom edge.
wins(red, T) :- red_chain(R1, C1, R2, C2, T), located_on(R1, C1, top), located_on(R2, C2, bottom), time(T).

% Rule: r_21899733a442  |  line_index: 5  |  NL: The blue player wins on a turn if there is at least one blue chain that contains at least one cell on the left edge and at least one cell on the right edge.
wins(blue, T) :- blue_chain(R1, C1, R2, C2, T), located_on(R1, C1, left), located_on(R2, C2, right), time(T).

% Rule: r_602c794f99b5  |  line_index: 6  |  NL: The game ends as soon as one player wins.
game_over(T) :- wins(P, T), player(P), time(T).
:- occurs(move(P), T), game_over(T-1).

% Rule: r_f9114a3ea374  |  line_index: 7  |  NL: The game cannot end in a draw.
:- time(25), not game_over(25).
